completedHostLog.timeLimit: This is the shell's reporting timestamp, not a measured exact crash instant. The host can report a background process termination when returning from a foreground command.
completedHostLog.interpretation: The specific emulator process terminated with a segmentation fault; device-unavailable messages are downstream and are not merely an unexplained ADB disconnect.

reportedCrashStore.text: INFO         | Storing crashdata in: /tmp/android-runner/emu-crash-37.2.13.db, detection is enabled for process: 6995

limitations: The log names crashdata storage and the shell says core dumped, but the retained archive contains neither crash database nor core/minidump/stack.
No faulting component can be identified from these logs.
No positive host OOM-kill evidence or deliberate terminating kill is present in the fetched terminal context. This does not establish that host memory pressure was absent.

The source cleanup's emu kill/kill/wait commands occur in the EXIT trap after evidence/verifier handling; the SIGSEGV diagnostic appears before that overall failure. A cleanup command is not supported as the observed termination cause.
The supported software selector was applied. This second SIGSEGV does not by itself justify another graphics flag or prove which renderer subcomponent failed.
